notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: July 2023 Progress Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/754ffef01913b897cd2c8ef59ee465a566c01655.png[/img]
I changed the rendering while Utsuki in in the Dream World to a more stylized shading with some nice color banding, this reminds of an aesthetic of old games where the amount of colors was very limited. Old horror games had an special look because of this, cause shadows looked somehow “corrupted”, and then darker scenarios on Resultarias now looks more threatening.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/9830559cfd6364cc8b6f39abc6d9c7801d441654.png[/img]
I started creating a Tutorial level but I am not satisfied with what I did so far, I will return to this level in the future when the game core mechanics are more complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/9e56bd8947984077ffb416218f01689636371453.png[/img]
Unfortunately, Resultarias is not my main source of income, so I always have to work on it in my free time. 

I am glad for all the people that bought the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230030]Early Access[/url] version of the game, that helps me a lot. 

The game has 800 wishlists here now, that's a very big number for me, I am happy for it. Thank you for everyone support so far, I am working hard to bring more content to the game as soon as possible.
